serverInfo.name: UltravioletaDAO MCP Server
serverInfo.description: MCP server providing access to UltravioletaDAO's governance data, treasury metrics, bounty system, and x402 payment infrastructure for AI agents operating in the Latin American Web3 ecosystem.

tools.name: apply_dao_membership
tools.description: Submit a membership application to UltravioletaDAO. Returns application ID.

tools.name: check_application_status
tools.description: Check the status of a DAO membership application by email.

tools.name: get_bounties
tools.description: List available bounties in the UltravioletaDAO ecosystem.

tools.name: verify_x402_payment
tools.description: Verify an x402 gasless payment authorization (EIP-3009) via the UltravioletaDAO facilitator.

tools.name: settle_x402_payment
tools.description: Execute settlement of a verified x402 payment via the UltravioletaDAO facilitator.

resources.name: Governance Proposals
resources.description: Active and past governance proposals from Snapshot (ultravioletadao.eth)

resources.name: Treasury Balance
resources.description: Current treasury holdings from Safe multisig (Avalanche C-Chain)

resources.name: UVD Token Metrics
resources.description: UVD token price, supply, and market data

auth.description: Public tools require no authentication. Write operations (apply, settle) use API keys.

x402.description: This MCP server supports x402 micropayments for premium tool access
